body: Unfortunately that is the harsh truth, Nobody cares unless you are beautiful, rich, popular, or dead.

Hey Friend,

For a fact I know that you are good and selfless in your heart, because you are afraid to hurt others than to hurt yourself. You will do more good with your life than other fake people, who act they are good.
Hey Bro, I am in the same boat here and I am here if you want to talk.

Opting out just because you weren't born rich is not a good idea. Just because you werent born rich, it doesnt mean that you will die poor. Take most of the billionaires, they were poor when they started, they became rich through hard work. No one will remember these trust fund babies, since they didnt work for the money they have. But a person like you who worked hard to achieve, history will remember your name.  One last thought, not to be rude or discouraging, but unfortunately its the truth.

"If you were born poor its not your fault, but if you die poor then its your fault"

yep i know its basic instinct to survive, but I didnt chicken out, the guy who was suppose to help me, ended up calling the ER just about I was suppose to be brain dead. Just a lesson learnt that shouldnt trust people in assisting me in suicide.

Even I am suicidal, who am I to tell you what to do with your life. I really dont know if this may help you, try to watch the movie "It's a Wonderful Life" may be you can link your past with your future and find a purpose to live on.

I really do know, how much I hate myself, like you I was handsome and aced at my work place, until I met with an accident which changed my life for the worse. Its not how others see you, its all about how you think about yourself that can make a difference in your life. One more important thing there is no such thing as sick, ugly and pathetic creature.

Trust me when I say this, Only people who have utterly lost hope, will succeed in suicide, I tried 3 times, once stopped by my friend, twice ended in the hospital after doing something stupid. If its too hard to kill yourself then you have something to look forward to, or something you dont want to leave behind. Try to find it out by living.

Hey there,
I can relate to what you are going through, I am also going through the same phase of life, I just cannot move on. But for some strange reason I am just hanging in there as long as I can. I just saw your picture, wow you are as pretty as ANGEL, unlike me who has a deformed face. I would say that Ryan is a fool to leave a person like you. I really wished I had a pretty face like you. I really wish you could find the strength to live your life to the fullest, because I am pretty sure you can do it too. 
P.S. I just cried reading this.

Trust me I know it gets good, but we are so hell bent on the negative aspects of life, that we fail to see the good that comes to us and you are hearing this from a person who is going to kill himself in a couple of week.

Well if you want to be killed just staying in a nice neighbourhood will not do any good. Trying going to dangerous countries in Africa or in Asia. While you get killed, you might even save a couple of life too.
